job_spec.name: qkd_ctrl_pc-ks2-fe58324a6
job_spec.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 (track B) HBM controller strip master qkd_ctrl_pc: ONE hardened per-PC leaf replaces the 12 mm qkd_ctrl / qkd_ctrl_n strip (32 slots a strip + qkd_ctrl_kc).  Tap station + ot_qwen_ctrl_pc_emb built for PC 0 with a strapped reset delay (cycle-exact to the parameterised scheduler) + pcport KVW 2 + landing ECC + embedding static crossing + command arbiter / read tags / write-done glue; registers at every pin; two roots (pll_hbm ~10k sinks, ck ~3k).  core_clk = ck (the embedding static crossing's core side, 833.333 ps); the HBM controller clock pll_hbm is the second root at its real 1,024 ps (sdc_extra, the form of qkd_cdc_wleaf).
